verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own AI assistant is documented to search your entire email history, read threads and check your calendar, which covers the core of asking questions across inbox and calendar. However, the evidence never shows grounded answers with source citations or 'what's outstanding' queries. Community reports also note that on the free plan, mail older than 90 days does not appear in search, which limits whole-inbox coverage. Missing for 10: evidence of grounded/cited answers, documented cross-inbox Q&A examples (who said what, outstanding items), hands-on corroboration, full-history search on all plans.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers

citations.quote: It’s incredibly capable: it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more.
